title: Turnover package and validation documents | Aquemi
meta: Every document delivered with our Purified Water package, under GMP or not, and site safety information. Request a specimen package.
headline: Every document your auditor asks for
lead: We write each document as we design, build and test your Purified Water package, and trace each line of your requirements (URS) to the document that proves it.

blocks.h: The turnover package, section by section
blocks.intro: Good manufacturing practice (GMP) closes testing with installation, operational and performance qualification (IQ, OQ, PQ). Not under GMP? The same stages apply, with commissioning and an acceptance test against your specification in place of qualification.

items.d: Register with current revisions, scope, tag list, connection points (battery limits)
URS compliance matrix, design basis, risk assessment, traceability matrix
Functional specification, P&IDs, general arrangement and layout
Cleaning certificate, pressure tests and registration where required
Calibration certificates, software version and backup
Factory and site acceptance tests. Under GMP: IQ, OQ and PQ. Not under GMP: commissioning and an acceptance test.
Operation and maintenance manual, draft operating procedures, spare parts list for the first period of operation, training records

blocks.intro: What your safety team needs for a permit or a pre-start review, read off the package itself.

blocks.intro: Aquemi-written specimen package, sent on request in a time confirmed when you enquire; cost discussed when you enquire.

fields.label: Documents you want
options: FAT protocol: contents and test cases

items.q: Can we see real documents before we order?
items.a: Yes. We send an Aquemi-written specimen package on request: the package index, protocol contents and record formats. Audit our quality system to see them in use.

items.q: Do you check third-party certificates, or just forward them?
items.a: We check them: markings and lot numbers against the certificate at receipt. Certificates reach you as the issuer sent them, never retyped. If you make products for clients, their auditors see the same records.

items.q: When do we see the protocols?
items.a: The factory acceptance test (FAT) protocol reaches your quality unit for approval ahead of testing, on a date agreed with you. Installation and operational qualification (IQ, OQ) protocols follow. They cite the FAT results your quality unit agreed to reuse (Health Canada GUI-0029).
